scarlet_phantom.base: Frenzy: Basic attack critical hits grant 30% Attack Speed and 5% Crit Chance for 2s. Shares Frenzy with Haas’ Claws.
scarlet_phantom.mythical: Frenzy: Basic attack critical hits grant 30% Attack Speed and 5% Crit Chance for 2s. Shares Frenzy with Haas’ Claws.

shadow_twinblades.base:
Assassination: After 5s without champion combat, the next basic attack against a hero deals 45 + 50% Magic Power bonus magic damage and slows by 50% for 1.5s.
Hybrid Lifesteal: Restore 4% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic and skill hits.
shadow_twinblades.mythical:
Assassination: After 5s without champion combat, the next basic attack against a hero deals 1.25 × (45 + 50% Magic Power) bonus magic damage and slows by 50% for 1.5s.
Hybrid Lifesteal: Restore 4% of enemy HP damage dealt by direct basic and skill hits.

ice_force.base: Frost Strike: A basic attack on a hero slows their movement by 25% and reduces their Attack Speed by 15% for 1.5s. Cooldown: 3s.
ice_force.mythical: Frost Strike: A basic attack on a hero slows their movement by 25% and reduces their Attack Speed by 15% for 1.5s. Cooldown: 3s.

bloodthirsty_king.base: Bloodlust: A hero kill or assist restores 12% maximum HP over 3s. Cooldown: 10s.
bloodthirsty_king.mythical: Bloodlust: A hero kill or assist restores 15% maximum HP over 3s. Cooldown: 10s.
